text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
"—The 'U.A.F.' generated immense excitement last year.
In-person viewing reservations for the 3rd Stage were trending all over social media."

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text: "I checked the site the second the date changed too, but the page was already loading so slowly...!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
"I watched the stream with my daughter,
and it got so exciting!
The participating runners were quite diverse too."

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
"With all the excitement surrounding the 'U.A.F.',
our program will now be featuring it
every single week!"

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: "First today, let's take a survey on who the live audience's favorite competitors are——"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...Ever since last year's 2nd Stage, the 'U.A.F.' would occasionally be featured on TV."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her presence in the public eye was steadily growing.
Feeling happy about it as if it were my own success,
I headed to today's 'U.A.F.' joint practice—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
—Great work today, everyone!!
Make sure to cool down properly, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
...Hm-hm-hm-hmm~♪
Hm-hm-hmm~♪

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I found it!
To put it plainly—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san has looked sooo happy lately!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: —As the U.A.F. grew more exciting, Ryoka became more motivated and enthusiastic than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
They look terribly busy,
but you can really tell how much fun they're having!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Watching Suzuka-san like that made me feel so warm and happy, almost as if it were happening to me!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: —Suzuka-san is usually so calm and gentle, but when the excitement peaks, she gets super sharp and cool!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Lately, it's just been razor-sharp!
Oh, but not in an angry way, I mean.
Like, razor-sharp precision, you know!
choice_data_list: You two get along so well, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Really?!
You really think so?!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~!
I'm kind of embarrassed...!
choice_data_list: How did you meet Ms. Tsurugi?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! I'm so glad you asked!
To tell you the truth, I was practically bursting at the seams to talk about that~!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
“This might take a liiittle while, though,
so how about we drink plenty of water as we go?”

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
—Um. It all started around the time
my streams were just beginning to get a little popular.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
—We got a message from Suzuka-san's company
asking if we'd like to work together.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: They wanted to feature me in a promotional video for sporting goods, so I readily agreed, but—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
I saw it as a chance to share the
wonder of sports with even more people.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: ...I figured I had nothing to lose, so I decided to ask for some advice.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
“—Thank you for your hard work. Now then,
taking today's discussion into account,
I will proceed with the matter.”

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"Once again, thank you very much
for readily accepting our proposal."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"N-No! Thank *you* so much
for reaching out to me!"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "...I hope that this project will help more people learn about Elfi-san's activities."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "I look forward to your continued support."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "......Excuse me!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"I know this is sudden and might seem rude!
But may I propose a plan of my own as well!?"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "Whaーー"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "It's something I've been thinking about for so, so long!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
“—I really just love sports so much!
Back when I was running in races, of course—”

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "Even after retiring from racing, those feelings remained just as bright and sparkling—"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"After retiring, I tried my hand at many different sports.
Every single one of them was truly so much fun—"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"And as I was doing that,
it just started welling up inside me...!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Racing isn't all there is
to sports for an Umamusume—"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: ""We Umamusume should be allowed to enjoy sports beyond just racing—""

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "The feeling that I should be having fun...!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm certain there are other Umamusume
like me out there who still love sports,
even after retiring."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "I want a place where... horse girls who love sports can gather and compete with passion and joy—"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
'Something that can make both the Uma Musume
and the people watching them excited……!'

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"A place like that!!
I want to create it!!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "B-But, doing it alone would be impossible...! I thought that maybe, just maybe, if I teamed up with your company since you're so big in entertainment...!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I'll put my all into
the project you proposed!!
On top of that, if it's okay with you, please—"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: “――...Is that Sonon Elfie's――”

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "Is it a 'dream'?"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"YES! That's right!!
What I want to do is—"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "That is my 'dream' right now!!"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"..................Understood.
Please, by all means, show me."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "‘...!! Thank you so very much!!’"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: —And what I showed them then was the original proposal that became the U.A.F.!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: ………………That made me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san read through my proposal with utmost seriousness—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "......I have seen it."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "...First and foremost, I must say that there are numerous hurdles for our company to make this proposed project a reality."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "'It was deemed so difficult that it would take a long period of thorough, meticulous preparation to even have a chance of succeeding.'"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Right............ of course.
I shouldn't just blurt something like this out out of nowhere—"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: “—However, more than anything, there is passion.”

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "Sonon Elfie-san. If you are prepared to take however much time it may require..."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"Would you allow our company... allow me,
to assist in making your 'dream' a reality?"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "In your 'dream,' I saw a sparkling passion and the potential for a whole new form of entertainment."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "If you don't mind, let us do so together—"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "Yes, please!! I'd be honored!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
—And so, I asked Ryoka-san
to become my partner
in making the 'U.A.F.' a reality.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-san talked to so many different people to get the project off the ground—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"You've supported my activities so much, too...
Preparing all sorts of things together, the two of us—"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Spending so much time together—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
And that brings us to the present day!!
Ta-da!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~! Do you think so~?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
......I have the utmost respect
for you, Ryoka-san.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Always giving everything to her work, taking immense pride in it, looking so cool—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Still, you're always mindful of those around you...
never once disregarding someone else's feelings.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever you're serious, she always meets you with equal sincerity...!
She's such a kind, passionate person...!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
At first, the U.A.F. was just a "dream" I wanted
to achieve for myself. But now, it's different—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of Ryoka-san, who's been working hard alongside us,
I want to make sure the "U.A.F." is an absolute success!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
...And also...
for Ryoka-san as well...—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: I'd be happy if it became a “dream.”
choice_data_list: I'm sure that is the case.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Experiencing the dawn of the U.A.F.,
I reaffirmed my resolve to give it my all
alongside <chrname> until the very end—
